name: Fia
source:
She is the daughter of Pariah, one of the seven pillars of the Green Forest, and the current deity who oversees "Bonds." Due to her lineage, she has been designated as the symbolic representative of the Fiushia religion, which originated in the Kingdom of Influs and later spread to other nations. After regaining her memories and understanding her role, she strives to authentically connect with people of all backgrounds, despite being frequently reminded to act in accordance with her divine status.

She suspects that the manifestation of the fort spirit in the world is linked to events from ancient times, and she endeavors to uncover the hidden secrets of the Principality of Mephi. Known for her cheerful and positive demeanor, she is candid and emotionally expressive. While she often speaks fervently, she also possesses a great sense of humor. Fond of small and adorable things, she cares for the spirit Kuna like a mother.
